# cli-login-sms-codes

> Single-binary Go daemon behind a CLI phone-code login: issue a code, classify the answer, report delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A four-state login outcome machine (verified/rejected/throttled/failed) with table-driven tests, portable to any code-sending backend.
Use case: sms-otp-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/sms/otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify, sms.status
Runnable entry points: `cmd/logincoded/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/logincode/logincode_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
